Regex Cheat Sheet

Searchable regex token reference plus a live tester with highlighted matches and capture groups.

No tokens match your search.

📖 How to use

  1. Type a pattern and optional flags.
  2. Paste or type sample text.
  3. Matches highlight live with groups listed.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Can I search the token table?

Yes — the token table filters as you type, by token or description.

How are matches shown?

Matches are highlighted in the sample text and numbered capture groups are listed below.

Can I set regex flags?

Yes — toggle global, case-insensitive, and multiline flags.

Which regex flavor is used?

The tester uses JavaScript's RegExp engine; syntax follows JS rules.
